conditions: Exceptions raised locally during the declaration or handler phase of a PL/SQL block, as described in both exact subsections of chapter 11.
limitations: These phase boundaries leave final error handling, rollback, and implementation propagation across remote database calls outside the claim.

triggers: Publisher revision, archived-byte drift, a documented qualifier, contrary source evidence or a controller change.

statement: Under the Oracle 19c reference, an exception raised in a declaration or in an exception handler goes immediately to the enclosing block, or to the invoker or host when there is no enclosing block. Handlers in the same block do not intercept it.
